niche: Frugal Home Hacks: save money at home (US families)
audience: US adults 30-64, mostly women and parents, who run a household on a budget
why: Biggest US Facebook audience (women 35-64), family/cooking/DIY content is earning again, and money-saving brings finance-type advertisers (higher CPM) without the expertise and risk of pure finance. It also fits the existing home & kitchen Shorts, Pinterest and shop, so content can be reused.
pillars: Grocery & kitchen savings (meal prep, food storage, stretching groceries)
Cleaning & organization hacks with cheap household items
Lower your bills (energy, water, subscriptions) with simple home changes
Useful budget finds under $30 (affiliate, with disclosure)
rules: Original only: your own script, voice, footage or AI visuals you made. No reposting other creators (Meta demonetizes duplicative content since March 2026).
No clickbait, no fake 'before/after', no medical or guaranteed-savings claims.
Affiliate links only with '#ad' / 'affiliate link' and never in paid ads.
Post at US Eastern times; Bangladesh is 10-11 hours ahead.
